title: RMS / fleet status UI check for AGV inactivity and active errors
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI at UPS Haslet TX (TXRTH) to determine whether an AGV is inactive and whether a system or AGV active error is associated with the bag-out stoppage. The incident evidence showed an AGV with approximately 3 hours without movement and advised checking the system active error when the AVEVA HMI was unavailable.
when_to_use: Use the RMS / fleet status UI when the site reports a bag-out stoppage and support needs to determine whether an AGV is inactive or whether an active error is visible. Use the RMS / fleet status UI as the available live diagnostic surface when the AVEVA HMI cannot be viewed.
not_for: Do not use this RMS / fleet status UI check as a physical AGV recovery or E-stop procedure.
Do not infer an out-of-sequence robot root cause from inactivity alone.
Do not substitute undocumented AVEVA HMI or physical-floor actions when the required RMS / fleet status UI information is unavailable.
This diagnostic does not by itself confirm resolution of the bag-out stoppage.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Perform the diagnostic inspection on the RMS / fleet status UI and preserve the visible inactivity and error results for support review.
Review or receive escalation when the RMS / fleet status UI shows an active AGV error, continued inactivity, or insufficient information to identify the affected robot.

safety_notes: This is a support-safe diagnostic inspection; it does not authorize a physical E-stop, production stop, or AGV handling action.
Stop the diagnostic and escalate when the RMS / fleet status UI shows an active AGV error, continued inactivity, or insufficient information to identify the affected robot.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS fleet activity or AGV status view
RMS system active error or AGV fault indicator

access_required: L1_support access to the RMS / fleet status UI
system_preconditions: The RMS / fleet status UI is available for inspection.
A current bag-out stoppage or related AGV inactivity condition is being investigated.

visual_references.description: RMS-style screenshot showing activity evidence that an AGV did not move for 3 hours; the exact AGV identifier and detailed table values are not legible.

steps.title: Open the RMS / fleet status UI activity view
steps.purpose: Reach the live RMS / fleet status UI view needed to inspect AGV activity and status.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the fleet activity or AGV status view. Use the visible activity list or status table for the affected site condition.
steps.expected_result: The RMS / fleet status UI displays an AGV activity or status view with live robot rows or status information available for inspection.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS / fleet status UI is available and shows identifiable AGV activity or status information.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS / fleet status UI activity or AGV status information is unavailable, blank, or does not provide enough information to identify the affected robot.

actions.label: Open RMS activity/status
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the fleet activity or AGV status view.

stop_or_escalate_if: The RMS / fleet status UI activity or AGV status information is unavailable.
The view does not provide enough information to identify the affected robot.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: When the AVEVA screen could not be seen, support advised checking the system active error; the candidate specifies the RMS / fleet status UI activity or AGV status view for this diagnostic.

steps.title: Inspect AGV movement duration in the RMS / fleet status UI
steps.purpose: Determine whether an AGV is inactive and capture the visible duration of inactivity.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI activity view, inspect the AGV activity information for a robot with no recent movement. Capture the visible AGV identifier, if available, and the displayed inactivity duration.
steps.expected_result: The RMS / fleet status UI shows either recent AGV movement or an inactivity duration associated with an identifiable AGV; the incident example showed approximately 3 hours without movement.
steps.healthy_condition: The affected AGV shows recent movement or no abnormal inactivity duration in the RMS / fleet status UI.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS / fleet status UI shows an AGV with no movement for an extended duration, including the incident-consistent observation of approximately 3 hours, or the affected AGV cannot be identified.

actions.label: Check AGV activity
actions.exact_action: Check the activity view for an AGV with no movement and record the visible inactivity duration.

stop_or_escalate_if: An AGV remains inactive in the RMS / fleet status UI.
The inactivity duration is visible but the affected AGV cannot be identified.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Activity was checked and an AGV did not move for 3 hours; the exact AGV identifier and detailed table values are not legible.

steps.title: Inspect active errors in the RMS / fleet status UI
steps.purpose: Determine whether a system active error or AGV fault is visible in the live RMS / fleet status UI.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI, inspect the available system active error or AGV fault indicator. Capture the displayed error code, description, affected robot, or other visible error identity.
steps.expected_result: The RMS / fleet status UI shows whether an active error is present and, when available, displays its code, description, or affected robot.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS / fleet status UI shows no active AGV or system error associated with the inspected condition.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS / fleet status UI displays an active AGV or system error, including an error code, description, or affected robot.

actions.label: Check system active error
actions.exact_action: Check the available system active error or AGV fault indicator in the RMS / fleet status UI and record any displayed error code, description, or affected robot.

stop_or_escalate_if: The RMS / fleet status UI shows an active AGV error.
The RMS / fleet status UI does not provide enough information to determine whether an active error is present.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Support advised checking the system active error when the AVEVA screen could not be seen.

steps.title: Compare RMS / fleet status UI results with the bag-out condition
steps.purpose: Relate the observed AGV inactivity and active-error state to the current bag-out stoppage without assigning an unsupported root cause.
steps.instruction: Compare the activity and active-error results visible in the RMS / fleet status UI with the current bag-out condition. Preserve the visible AGV identifier, inactivity duration, error code, description, affected robot, and any unavailable values for L2 support review.
steps.expected_result: The RMS / fleet status UI findings identify whether continued AGV inactivity or an active error is present alongside the bag-out condition, or clearly show that the required information is unavailable.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS / fleet status UI shows recent AGV activity and no active error associated with the inspected bag-out condition.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS / fleet status UI shows continued AGV inactivity, such as approximately 3 hours without movement, an active error, or insufficient information to correlate the AGV state with the bag-out condition.

actions.label: Compare live RMS findings
actions.exact_action: Compare the activity result and active-error result with the current bag-out condition; stop the diagnostic if the AGV remains inactive or an active error is present and preserve the observed values for support review.

stop_or_escalate_if: The AGV remains inactive in the RMS / fleet status UI.
An active error is present in the RMS / fleet status UI.
The RMS / fleet status UI does not provide sufficient information to identify or correlate the affected robot.
Do not infer an out-of-sequence root cause from inactivity alone.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The incident linked an AGV inactivity observation of 3 hours to the bag-out troubleshooting context but did not establish that this diagnostic alone resolved the stoppage.

success_criteria: The RMS / fleet status UI provides an observable AGV activity result, including recent movement or a visible inactivity duration.
The RMS / fleet status UI provides an observable active-error result, including no active error or visible error details.
Any continued inactivity, active error, or insufficient identifying information is preserved and escalated to L2 support.
healthy_conditions: The affected AGV shows recent movement in the RMS / fleet status UI.
No active AGV or system error is visible in the RMS / fleet status UI.
The activity and active-error results are sufficiently identifiable for support review.
failure_conditions: An AGV shows extended inactivity in the RMS / fleet status UI, including approximately 3 hours without movement.
An active AGV or system error is visible in the RMS / fleet status UI.
The RMS / fleet status UI does not expose sufficient activity or error information to identify the affected robot.
The diagnostic result does not establish the root cause or resolution of the bag-out stoppage.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate to L2 support if the RMS / fleet status UI shows an active AGV error.
Stop and escalate to L2 support if the RMS / fleet status UI shows continued AGV inactivity.
Escalate to L2 support if the RMS / fleet status UI does not provide enough information to identify the affected robot.
Do not substitute undocumented AVEVA HMI or physical-floor actions when the RMS / fleet status UI information is unavailable.
